findings.citation_text: The moiré pattern can be canceled if the magnitudes of spatial displaying vectors a,b are exact integer multiples of those of the spatial re-sampling vectors dc,ec, respectively [26]. The MSPs generated from the near-integer multiple (NM) relation between the sampling periods in the displaying and imaging devices are, therefore, observable in most recaptured document images.
